fact: From 1 to 13 November 2026 INSTAT Gabon hosted an expert mission to prepare the SNDS II (2023-2025) evaluation report, the national statistical system diagnostic and the strategic orientations document of the SNDS 2026-2030.
title: SNDS 2026-2030 : Deuxième mission de l'expert international Alain Brilleau à l'INSTAT Gabon
